# Generate all permutations of 0 to 10
perms = list(permutations(range(11)))

# Check each permutation

    # Calculate the absolute differences between consecutive elements
    diffs = [abs(perm[i] - perm[i-1]) for i in range(1, 11)]

    if sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, 11)):
        print(perm)
        break
else:
